messages.content: 誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？

function.name: search_music_instrument_players
function.description: Searches for top music instrument players in a specified music genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument.description: The type of musical instrument, e.g. trumpet

top.description: Number of top players to return. Default is 5.

message.content:
以下列出一些被廣泛認為在爵士樂界具有極高聲譽與影響力的歌手（排名不分先後）：

| 名稱 | 代表作品 / 標誌性風格 | 為何被視為頂尖 |
|------|---------------------|---------------|
| **Billie Holiday** (1930s‑1950s) | “Strange Fruit”, “God Bless the Child” | 她獨特的情感表達、即興技巧和對音色的掌控，奠定了現代爵士歌唱的基礎。 |
| **Ella Fitzgerald** (1940s‑1990s) | “Summertime”, “Dream a Little Dream of Me” | 被譽為“天籟之聲”，以無瑕的音準、卓越的即興能力和多樣化曲風聞名。 |
| **Sarah Vaughan** (1950s‑2000s) | “Misty”, “Lullaby of Birdland” | 她擁有四個八度以上的音域，能夠將抒情與即興完美結合。 |
| **Nina Simone** (1950s‑2000s) | “Feeling Good”, “I Put a Spell on You” | 將爵士、藍調、靈魂音樂融合，並以政治意識強烈的演繹方式著稱。 |
| **Cassandra Wilson** (1980s‑present) | “Waltz for Debby”, “The First Time Ever I Saw Your Face” | 她的低沉嗓音和跨流派編排使她成為當代爵士女歌手的代表。 |
| **Diana Krall** (1990s‑present) | “The Look of Love”, “All of Me” | 她的鋼琴伴奏與柔和嗓音相得益彰，深受全球聽眾喜愛。 |
| **Norah Jones** (2000s‑present) | “Don’t Know Why”, “Come Away With Me” | 雖屬於更輕鬆的爵士/民謠風格，但其商業成功與藝術品質兼具。 |
| **Esperanza Spalding** (2010s‑present) | “I Know You Know”, “Good Lava” | 她作為一位多才多藝的薩克斯風手兼歌手，以創新即興和跨界合作而聞名。 |
| **Robert Glasper** (2010s‑present) | “Afro Blue”, “The Artistry of Robert Glasper” | 他把嘻哈元素融入爵士，推動了「Jazz Rap」子類別的發展。 |

> **備註**：如果你想了解某位歌手的詳細傳記、專輯列表或演出歷史，我可以再提供更深入的資訊。
message.reasoning: The user asks "誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？" which means "Who is the best jazz singer?" They want a list of top singers. We can use the function search_music_instrument_players but it's for instrument players, not singers. There's no function for singers. So we need to answer manually. Provide a list of top jazz singers. Use knowledge up to 2024. Provide maybe 10 names. Also ask if they want more info.
